subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Planetary Gear Sets: Sun, Planet, Ring
description: Learn Planetary Gear Sets: Sun, Planet, Ring in one minute.

hook.text: A central sun gear, orbiting planet gears, and an outer ring gear — three elements, dozens of ratio options.

buildup.text: Planet gears mesh with both the sun and ring simultaneously. A carrier holds the planets in orbit.

discovery.text: Lock the ring and the sun drives the carrier slowly. Lock the carrier and the sun drives the ring faster.

twist.text: One planetary set can produce multiple gear ratios by locking different elements. That's why automatics use them.

climax.text: The Toyota Prius uses a planetary set to blend gasoline and electric power seamlessly. No shifting needed.

punchline.text: Lock one part. Free the others. Instant new gear ratio.

quiz.question: How does a planetary gear set produce different gear ratios?
options: By changing the number of planet gears in the carrier
By locking different elements — sun, ring, or carrier — to change the power path
By replacing gears of different sizes each time a new ratio is needed
